title: Efficiency of carbon dioxide capture with metal substitutions in the MIL-88A metal–organic framework
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1425-1437
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07861F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Do Ngoc Son, Viorel Chihaia, Nguyen Thi Xuan Huynh
We evaluated the efficiency of CO2 capture for various metal substitutions in the MIL-88A metal–organic framework. Ga and Al emerged as the most effective candidates among the considered metals.
